summary: The post-tag fast-forward job mints a GitHub App installation token (actions/create-github-app-token@v1, secrets PLATE_APP_ID + PLATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY) scoped to the repo for checkout/push; missing secrets log ::warning:: and skip the push. GH_TOKEN remains the default token for gh API issue comments. PR gates issue-link step treats Refs #N like a development sidebar link (#1438).
migration_impact: Adopters need both App secrets and ruleset bypass for automated FF on user-owned repos, or accept manual/admin finalize; org repos may use github-actions bypass instead.
migration_guidance: 1. Install a GitHub App on the repo with Contents, Issues, Pull requests, Actions, and Checks permissions; add PLATE_APP_ID and PLATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY repository secrets.
2. Add the App as an Always-allow bypass actor on the standing release-branch ruleset (or grant github-actions bypass where policy allows).
3. Without both secrets the workflow warns and skips the push; use gh plate release finalize or manual git fast-forward.
agent_notes: Unit tests parse release.yml (repo + template_payload) for the FF job. End-to-end App token minting is not exercised in CI.
